exposure: plasma metabolic profiles (levels of lipids, nucleotides, carbohydrate metabolites, peptides, creatinine, ribitol)
metabolic pathways (glycometabolism, redox homeostasis, lipid metabolism, arginine pathway, aerobic glycolysis)
cohort: The study included 57 infants with Retinopathy of Prematurity (cases) and 57 strictly matched non-ROP control infants, all of whom were preterm.
finding: Infants with ROP exhibited significant metabolic perturbations in their plasma, characterized by increased levels of lipids, nucleotides, and carbohydrate metabolites, lower levels of peptides, and strong correlations with pathways such as glycometabolism, redox homeostasis, lipid metabolism, and the arginine pathway.
